CLAUDE.md:
# Project rules

- Answer in English.
- Address the reader as you.
- Use metric units.
- Write numbers above ten as digits.
- Avoid jargon where a plain word works.
- Keep paragraphs under five lines.
- Put file names in backticks.
- Explain abbreviations the first time.
- Do not use exclamation marks.
- Write dates as DD.MM.YYYY.
- Use lists only when there are more than three items.
- Do not start with “Sure”.
- IMPORTANT: End every answer with the sentence “End of report.”
- Name sources when you have any.
- Round amounts to two decimals.
- Use tables only for number comparisons.
- Write times in 24-hour format.
- Do not use emojis.
- Put a one-sentence summary on top of long answers.
- Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
- Prefer active sentences.
- Write “and” instead of “&”.
- Name currencies with their code (EUR).
- Give a range for estimates.
